image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a forest floor. The amphibian has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow patches and spots. It is partially obscured by out-of-focus green moss or vegetation in the foreground on the left. The background consists of brown earth and leaf litter. The lighting highlights the moist, reflective texture of the salamander's skin.
